# IMQCallHooks interface

The subset of `@imqueue/rpc`<!-- -->'s default option singletons this instrumentation mutates. `beforeCall`<!-- -->/`afterCall` are used on the client; `wrapCall` (the around-hook) is used on the service so the handler runs inside the span's OpenTelemetry context.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IMQCallHooks 
```

</td><td>


</td><td>

Function


</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Runs after a client receives a response. Marks the span `ERROR` if the response carries one, then ends it.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[beforeCall?](/api/opentelemetry/latest/opentelemetry.imqcallhooks.beforecall/)


</td><td>


</td><td>

Function


</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Runs before a client sends a request. Starts the CLIENT span and injects its trace context into the request metadata.


</td></tr>
<tr><td>

[wrapCall?](/api/opentelemetry/latest/opentelemetry.imqcallhooks.wrapcall/)


</td><td>


</td><td>

Function


</td><td>

_(Optional)_ Wraps a service's handling of a request — an around-hook receiving a `next` callback. Used instead of a before/after pair so the handler can run INSIDE the SERVER span's context, which is what makes spans created downstream nest under it.


</td></tr>
</tbody></table>
